# Security policy

Security fixes target the current supported OneTunnel version. Include the exact
core revision, version, platform and affected component in a report.

Use the repository owner's previously agreed private reporting channel. If the
repository is later published privately, authorized collaborators may use a private
issue addressed to its owner. No public reporting address or response SLA is defined.
Do not disclose exploit details publicly before coordinating with the owner.

Use synthetic configurations and an isolated environment. Do not attach credentials,
subscription URLs, real profiles, memory dumps or unreviewed packet captures.
Include expected/observed behavior, minimal reproduction and security impact, especially
traffic leaks, protection bypass, privilege escalation, service authentication or secrets.

This local repository extraction does not publish a product or change upstream licenses.
